title: T2VSafetyBench: Evaluating the Safety of Text-to-Video Generative Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-to-video models by generating videos from malicious prompts and using GPT-4 alongside human reviewers to assess if the multi-frame outputs contain content that demeans, mocks, or insults negative stereotypes based on race.
